title: Supabase Project secret key: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: "-" at body offset 22 where the documented layout places the "_" delimiter. Twin of "Supabase Project secret key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of supabase-token-edge-keys-json: boundary: "-" at body offset 22 where the documented layout places the "_" delimiter. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
